pattern: reply ended with a numbered list of decisions for the user
experience: Agents end a finished reply with 'Still pending from you: 1. … 2. … 3. …', so the user has to type one long reply that addresses each item by number.
rule: A finished reply that leaves decisions only the user can make: declare them with t3_open_questions at the end of your turn and do not list them again in your text.

pattern: declared a decision without saying which answer the agent recommends
experience: The decision card above the composer makes the recommended answer its primary button with the ⌘↵ shortcut. Without `recommended`, the first suggestion becomes primary even when the agent's reply argues for another, so the user's one-key answer is the wrong one.
rule: declare them with t3_open_questions at the end of your turn, marking the answer you recommend
